notes.title: Cloud-Saving arrived! Update to Version 1.02.00
notes.content:
- Cloud saving is now available!
Make sure to launch the game once on the machine where your save was originally created to upload it to the cloud.

- Fixed a rare issue where using the Oni Stomp while entering a boss room could make the player invincible.

- Fixed a hitbox issue during the final boss fight.

- Fixed a rare issue with the rope mechanic in Phase 1 of the final boss fight.

- Fixed a rare bug where the hand of the final boss in Phase 2 could be incorrectly rotated.

- Corrected the element descriptions in the ring menu when playing as an Oni.

- Improved the layout of the tutorial room where the Oni Stomp is introduced for better clarity.

notes.title: Update to Ver 1.00.7
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare issue where using the Wind-Talisman during the Kaze-No-Kami Bossfight to destroy projectiles would sometimes result in not being able to reach Phase 3
- Fixed the mobile music player (Press L1 or R1 on the Quickmap) - Change Tracks on the fly during the adventure
- Fixed an issue where the water projectile in oni form would not be destroyed after some time

notes.title: Update to Ver 1.00.6
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the Oni-Stomp could trigger an Orb twice
- Fixed an issue where orb-timer wouldn't reset properly after falling into spikes.
- Placed HP+MP filling shrine in front of a platforming challenge in the cave
- Added a prompt before loading the Main-Menu or closing the Game via the Menu-Book that needs confirmation and shows the time that has passed since the game has been saved
- Final-Bossroom will keep the status "discovered" for map completion, after reaching the good or bad ending
- Made adjustments to the Suiko-Arcademinigame
- Added a barkwindow over the dojo-npc.
- Changed animation of Hyakumes attack for better visibility of the hitbox
- Boss Familiars are now stronger
- Unlocking Tanuki-Familiar now costs 3 instead of 1 Tanuki-Coin. Therefore 1 Tanuki-Coin has been added near every Tanuki-Statue (5)
- Fixed an issue where the control-layout could change automatically if using a controller and keyboard+mouse
- Fixed an issue where the Player-Portraitwould sometimes keep the "got-hit"-animation
- Made adjustments to the sound of the oni-stomp

notes.title: Update to Ver 1.00.5
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare issue where the Tanuki-Familiar could save the player 2 times instead of just 1, Reduced invincibility timer from 2 to 1 sec
- Fixed an issue where under specific circumstances a familiar would stop attack the Cave-Boss
- Health Changes to Final Boss
- Set Damage for Firebreath attack of Final Boss
- Menubook now opens at the last opened page instead "Status"
- Locked Abilities descriptons are now hidden on the status-page
- Fixed an issue where Jump could be stacked during collecting Kodamas
- Fixed a very rare issue where the onibozu could become invincible
- Fixed unlocking the achievement "Pure Water" - if the quest is already solved it should unlock on restarting the game
- Now markers can be placed in the Quickmap
- Status Page now shows strength-level
- added HP-filling shrines in front of every Boss
- added Particle-Effect to collectible ores for better visibility 
- added a hint after collecting the wind-scroll for the next direction

notes.title: Cyberportal Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare issue where the Cyberportal of the KawausoGirl won't disappear after clearing in the ricefarm area
- Fixed a rare issue where the Cybperportal of BadHairGirl wouldn't appear in the edojo area

notes.title: Tengubi Fix
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where the Card from Tengubi would not be added to the inventory

notes.title: Shop Improvements and more
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the slot for buying wouldn't be highlighted in the Food/Talisman shop to make sure Materials won't go to waste.
- Fixed an issue where the Gaki could push the player into the ground with itsdeadly attack while the Tanuki-Familiar is absorbing the hit.
- Fixed an issue where the Final Boss wouldn't use one of its attacks in Phase 2

notes.title: Yokai_Door Fix in Cyberspace and more
notes.content:
- Fixed rare occasion where a Yokai-Door won't open after clearing the Yokai-Zone in Cyberspace
- Miminashi LP need reduced to 8
- Special Ability Cooldowns reduced
- Fixed localizations issue in german for LP_Cave2 and Garappa_Shell
- Added an extra Platform in a Cyberspace Zone where 1 tile of jump height was missing as Jonah

notes.title: Exploit Fix
notes.content:
* Fixed an exploit where you could get infinite Gacha-Tickets in the Clawcrane
* Changed Cost and Possession (Visuals) in Tanuki-SpecialSkill-Menu
* Fixed an Issue where the Gaki-Familiar would deny enemy drops
Ver. to 1.00.1

notes.title: 🎮 Ninja Brigade – Steam Next Fest Update! 🎮
notes.content:
Big news, ninjas! We’ve expanded the Ninja Brigade demo for Steam Next Fest with exciting new features! 🏯✨

🔹 Cyberspace Levels – Enter the digital realm to rescue villagers and grow your village!
🔹 Dojo Training – Strengthen your abilities and become an even more powerful warrior!

We hope you enjoy the demo so far! Your feedback is always welcome—let us know what you think! If you encounter any issues, post them here, and we’ll make sure to sort them out. ✅

Try the updated demo now, and get ready—the full release isn’t far away! 🚀
